title: Redex fixture_set R2 manifest (F5 §11)
description: The manifest a replay engine (#2 device_config, #4 panel_state_machine) loads to drive a FAITHFUL, INTERACTIVE replica of a recorded device session — NEVER a live API (invariant 6). It maps to a row in academy.fixture_sets: source -> academy.fixture_source enum, version -> the platform-surface version, r2_manifest_key -> where this JSON lives, and `sanitized: true` is the PUBLISH GATE the DB trigger enforces (production customer footage is never a training fixture). Every screen carries an R2 image key + interactive hotspots/field map so the engine can replay the device UI offline.

rect.description: Hotspot bounding box in the fixture image's pixel space.

hotspot.description: An interactive region on a fixture screen. `navigate` moves to another screen; `set_field` edits a mapped device field (the engine records the edit order for set_before/reassigned_before assertions).

fieldMapEntry.description: A device field exposed on this screen, with its RECORDED value from the sanitized session (the faithful default the replica shows before the learner edits it).

source.description: MUST equal an academy.fixture_source enum value (migrations/0001_init_academy.sql). Keep 1:1 with the DB enum — a migration + typegen for any new source, never a hand-drift.

sanitized.description: PUBLISH GATE (invariant 6). A published sim may only reference a fixture with sanitized=true; the DB trigger tg_block_unsanitized_fixture enforces it. A manifest must declare it true to be loadable for field content.

synthetic.description: True if this fixture is hand-authored/illustrative (no real session recorded) rather than a sanitized real capture. Synthetic fixtures are still sanitized=true by construction (they contain no real data).
